# Known divergences of the standalone runtime from GNU Emacs 31.1.
#
# Origin: fd4c2e282 (2026-11-09) put interactive commands back into the
# parity-fuzz name pool; most are editor commands this runtime does not
# define (void-function), plus type-representation and value differences.
# Generated by the deterministic per-name scheme (seed 1, 3 cases per name,
# every name of the compat table; see tools/nelisp-parity-fuzz.el):
#   NELISP_FUZZ_WRITE_BASELINE=1 make parity-fuzz
#
# Ratchet rule (tools/nelisp-parity-fuzz.el): the gate FAILS on a divergent
# name that is not listed here (new divergence) and FAILS on a listed name
# that was exercised and now agrees (stale entry: delete the line).  The
# list therefore only shrinks.  Never add a name to hide a regression;
# fix the divergence or justify it in the commit.  A listed name the
# name the host Emacs lacks (oracle gap) or whose calls all abort is neither
# new nor stale.
